import json

lines = open('output/conll_mf4v2_seed42/samples.jsonl').readlines()
print(f'Total instances: {len(lines)}')

# compute MV F1, oracle F1, degeneracy
total_tp_mv = 0; total_fp_mv = 0; total_fn_mv = 0
total_tp_greedy = 0; total_fp_greedy = 0; total_fn_greedy = 0
total_tp_oracle = 0; total_fp_oracle = 0; total_fn_oracle = 0
n_degenerate = 0
fleiss_sum = 0; sj_sum = 0; n_valid = 0

for line in lines:
    d = json.loads(line)
    gold_ents = set()
    for e in d['gold']['entities']:
        gold_ents.add((e['text'], e['type'], e['start'], e['end']))

    # extract sample entity sets
    sample_ent_sets = []
    for s in d['samples']:
        ent_set = set()
        for e in s['entities']:
            ent_set.add((e['text'], e['type'], e['start'], e['end']))
        sample_ent_sets.append(ent_set)

    # greedy
    greedy_ents = set()
    for e in d['greedy']['entities']:
        greedy_ents.add((e['text'], e['type'], e['start'], e['end']))

    tp_g = len(greedy_ents & gold_ents)
    total_tp_greedy += tp_g
    total_fp_greedy += len(greedy_ents) - tp_g
    total_fn_greedy += len(gold_ents) - tp_g

    # degeneracy: all 8 samples identical
    if len(set(frozenset(s) for s in sample_ent_sets)) == 1:
        n_degenerate += 1

    # majority vote: entity appears in >= threshold samples
    threshold = len(d['samples']) // 2  # 4 out of 8
    all_ents = set()
    for s in sample_ent_sets:
        all_ents |= s
    mv_ents = set()
    for ent in all_ents:
        count = sum(1 for s in sample_ent_sets if ent in s)
        if count >= threshold:
            mv_ents.add(ent)

    tp_mv = len(mv_ents & gold_ents)
    total_tp_mv += tp_mv
    total_fp_mv += len(mv_ents) - tp_mv
    total_fn_mv += len(gold_ents) - tp_mv

    # oracle: best sample per instance
    best_tp = 0; best_fp = 999999; best_fn = 999999; best_f1 = -1
    for s_ents in sample_ent_sets:
        tp_s = len(s_ents & gold_ents)
        fp_s = len(s_ents) - tp_s
        fn_s = len(gold_ents) - tp_s
        p = tp_s / (tp_s + fp_s) if (tp_s + fp_s) > 0 else 0
        r = tp_s / (tp_s + fn_s) if (tp_s + fn_s) > 0 else 0
        f1 = 2*p*r/(p+r) if (p+r) > 0 else 0
        if f1 > best_f1:
            best_f1 = f1
            best_tp = tp_s; best_fp = fp_s; best_fn = fn_s
    total_tp_oracle += best_tp
    total_fp_oracle += best_fp
    total_fn_oracle += best_fn

# compute micro F1
def micro_f1(tp, fp, fn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0
    r = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
    return 2*p*r/(p+r) if (p+r) > 0 else 0

mv_f1 = micro_f1(total_tp_mv, total_fp_mv, total_fn_mv)

degen_rate = n_degenerate / len(lines)

print(f'oracle_f1: {oracle_f1:.4f}')

print(f'degeneracy_rate: {degen_rate:.4f} ({n_degenerate}/{len(lines)})')
print(f'degen_pct: {degen_rate*100:.1f}%')

# alpha_crit

alpha_crit = pi_mv / (2 - pi_mv)
alpha_crit_eff = alpha_crit / (1 - degen_rate)
print(f'alpha_crit: {alpha_crit:.4f} (= pi_MV / (2 - pi_MV))')
print(f'alpha_crit_eff: {alpha_crit_eff:.4f} (= alpha_crit / (1 - delta))')
